claim_rule: implementation_verified requires every row with required_for_implementation_verified=true and every linked required fault case against one candidate manifest; live_qualified additionally requires every row with required_for_live_qualified=true, including separately authorized T4 evidence.

altitudes.T0: schema, fixture, migration and static package contract
altitudes.T1: pure model/store/state-machine test without process boundary
altitudes.T2: direct host or real subprocess integration
altitudes.T4: separately authorized real provider or real host child

rows.requirement: Current v1 RLM schemas and canonical valid/invalid fixture bytes remain unchanged.
rows.setup: Load frozen v1 schemas/fixtures from the baseline release.
rows.action: Generate the successor schema bundle and read v1 bytes/digests.
rows.expected: Byte/digest equality and all existing v1 invalid fixtures still fail closed.

rows.requirement: All additive workbench, directive, broker-frame, caller-ticket, broker-context, artifact-binding and result schemas are strict and versioned.
rows.setup: Generate candidate schemas.
rows.action: Round-trip valid fixtures; for every frame kind run empty-payload, missing-field, extra-field, wrong-direction and type/size/version mutants; then run portable-regex attacks for overlapping bounded quantifiers, trailing-dollar newline divergence and ECMAScript-Unicode identity escapes.
rows.expected: Valid bytes canonicalize deterministically; every adversarial fixture fails before mutation, authority lookup or regex-engine compilation; accepted patterns contain at most one bounded quantified atom and no trailing end anchor.

rows.requirement: Generated schema/fixture/profile/skill digests bind the same candidate surface.
rows.setup: Build generated assets twice from a clean tree.
rows.action: Compare byte sets and digests.
rows.expected: Deterministic equality; no hand-maintained stale projection.

rows.requirement: Populated WAL-mode v5 registries migrate additively under durable cutover authority without stale-snapshot rollback after candidate writes.
rows.setup: Generate the exact populated v5 fixture; commit a row that remains in WAL; hold the admission/write/dispatch fence; create and verify a SQLite backup API snapshot and prepared authority event.
rows.action: Migrate with DDL, schema row and migration attestation in one transaction; compare canonical v5 data rows; validate the pre-write rollback path and the post-write forward-retirement path; attempt rollback after post_snapshot_write.
rows.expected: Snapshot includes WAL rows; populated v5 data digest is unchanged; attestation and hash chain match; rollback_before_write reopens with v5; rollback after post_snapshot_write is rejected and v6 remains authoritative.

rows.requirement: Generated Hermes/Codex profile prose and capability projection match the configured caller-work/model/subagent route exactly.
rows.setup: Generate profiles from one candidate configuration.
rows.action: Compare launcher args, live capability rows, profile text and skill instructions.
rows.expected: No profile claims host-owned model/subagent execution while live capability reports it unconfigured.

rows.requirement: Caller-delegated jobs require start_only and cannot deadlock waiting for the same blocking caller to service a ticket.
rows.setup: Tool admission matrix for caller_delegated/service_managed and start_only true/false.
rows.action: Submit every combination with and without a qualified duplex host driver and lease keeper.
rows.expected: Caller-delegated + blocking is rejected pre-admission; service-managed blocking requires configured broker/keeper; admitted combinations make progress.

rows.requirement: Model, subagent, evidence, artifact and effect methods report configured backend kind/evidence tier/reference-only truth consistently.
rows.setup: Reference-only host, partially configured host, and fully configured host.
rows.action: Read capabilities/catalog and attempt full-journey admission on each host.
rows.expected: Reference fakes are marked reference_only; missing required adapters block admission; only the fully configured host advertises and runs the complete journey.

rows.requirement: One aar_rlm_workbench_execute request creates one durable operation and one operation-scoped IPython generation.
rows.setup: Direct ReferenceHost with fake caller-work hosts and IPython backend.
rows.action: Submit start_only workbench job and inspect operation/workspace binding.
rows.expected: One operation, one generation, exclusive owner, bounded handle; caller performs no manual workspace create/execute.

rows.requirement: Root planner emits a strict execute_cell directive and the cell mutates persistent workbench state.
rows.setup: Fake model receipt returns a valid directive.
rows.action: Resume job, execute cell, inspect next revision and bounded event summary.
rows.expected: State persists within generation; source/result/checkpoint digests bind the RLM step.

rows.requirement: Model-written Python performs a recursive caller-delegated model request and receives the certain result after suspension.
rows.setup: Cell invokes aar.model.request with a fake caller host.
rows.action: Run until suspension, reserve and mark send-started, commit ticket, then test live resume and lost-stack recovery continuation.
rows.expected: One physical logical call; surviving stack resumes or recovery planner creates a new cell; cumulative usage increments once.

rows.requirement: Model-written Python requests a retained subagent and consumes its bounded result after suspension.
rows.setup: Cell invokes aar.agents.run with a fake caller child host.
rows.action: Reserve/mark child submit and result tickets, return retained handle/result, then resume or recovery-plan continuation.
rows.expected: Parent/child lineage and receipt are exact; fake reference result is not advertised as real native child capability.

rows.requirement: aar.complete produces one bounded terminal result with validated output, named artifacts, usage, child lineage and workspace disposition.
rows.setup: Successful job with model call, child result and two artifacts.
rows.action: Finalize and read result/artifacts.
rows.expected: One certain result; every artifact resolves; no unresolved required work; no delivery claim.

rows.requirement: Frontend/main-agent disconnect does not cancel or lose the operation, pending tickets or final result.
rows.setup: Full MCP and durable supervisor with a waiting caller ticket.
rows.action: Terminate frontend, attach fresh frontend, claim/commit and read terminal result.
rows.expected: Same operation identity; no duplicate work; bounded event cursor and result readback.

rows.requirement: Every worker-frame variant round-trips with exact kind, direction, committed authority, typed payload, identity, digest, sequence, deadline and size validation.
rows.setup: Generated per-variant positive and atomic negative protocol fixtures.
rows.action: Round-trip valid frames and feed empty/missing/extra/wrong-direction plus wrong version/identity/digest/sequence/type frames.
rows.expected: Valid frames are deterministic; every invalid frame fails closed without broker, artifact, cancellation, terminal or rebind authority.

rows.requirement: User stdout/stderr and rich display cannot corrupt or impersonate protocol frames.
rows.setup: Real IPython worker prints frame-like JSON and binary/unicode output.
rows.action: Execute cell while broker bridge is active.
rows.expected: Output remains captured events; only dedicated framed channel drives broker router.

rows.requirement: Unresolved external broker call suspends certainly and supports live resume or lost-stack recovery from the exact pre-cell checkpoint.
rows.setup: Portable pre-cell state and one new model intent in surviving-worker and killed-worker variants.
rows.action: Suspend and settle the receipt; resume the surviving worker, then restore/recovery-plan for the killed worker.
rows.expected: Surviving stack resumes exactly; lost cell is never automatically replayed; recovery creates a new cell and duplicates zero external calls.

rows.requirement: Caller-work identity or request-digest conflict never executes external work.
rows.setup: Persist a ticket/receipt, then alter logical owner, method contract or request digest under the same identity.
rows.action: Attempt claim, send-start, commit and recovery continuation.
rows.expected: Operation parks/quarantines with both digests; no second physical call.

rows.requirement: Frame count/bytes, cell source, events, results and broker payloads enforce admitted ceilings.
rows.setup: Boundary and over-bound fixtures.
rows.action: Decode/execute each boundary case.
rows.expected: Exact boundary succeeds; over-bound fails before durable/external effect.

rows.requirement: Live-stack successor rebind transfers exactly one durable continuation authority across coordinator crash/restart.
rows.setup: Settled suspension, live write-fenced predecessor, prepared successor token and crash hooks before durable commit, after commit before delivery, and after delivery before acknowledgement.
rows.action: Crash and restart at each barrier; retry exact prepare/commit delivery, then test worker acknowledgement and committed-worker loss.
rows.expected: Before commit the predecessor remains fenced and the transfer may abort/retry; after commit the exact token is idempotently redelivered and only the successor fence is current. Acknowledgement consumes the token; lost committed worker is fenced and recovery-planned from checkpoint without reviving the predecessor or creating two continuation owners.

rows.requirement: DB-backed artifact put/read are safe under dispatcher-thread concurrency.
rows.setup: Real SQLite repository with multiple worker threads.
rows.action: Concurrent bounded put/read with duplicate content.
rows.expected: No thread-affinity error, correct dedupe/refcounts/bytes, stable digests.

rows.requirement: DB-backed reference subagent submit/status are safe under dispatcher-thread concurrency.
rows.setup: Real SQLite reference repository with multiple worker threads.
rows.action: Concurrent idempotent submits and status reads.
rows.expected: No thread-affinity error, duplicate submit returns one handle, stable result.

rows.requirement: Repository close waits/fences active use and later calls fail with a typed closed-state error.
rows.setup: Active put/submit from worker thread.
rows.action: Race ReferenceHost close with the operation.
rows.expected: No use-after-close/SQLite corruption; deterministic completion or typed cancellation.

rows.requirement: Every inner mutation validates BrokerContext v2 attempt/workspace/cell fence.
rows.setup: Current and stale AttemptFence fixtures for each broker method and RLM step/result store.
rows.action: Attempt writes from both fences.
rows.expected: Current writes pass; stale authoritative writes are rejected; matching late callbacks can append candidate receipts only.

rows.requirement: Facade methods require the exact host-issued grant and cumulative budget reservation.
rows.setup: Catalog with allowed/denied method grants and low budgets.
rows.action: Invoke each facade method under valid, missing, stale and over-budget contexts.
rows.expected: Only authorized calls execute; denial/over-budget is durable, typed and pre-effect.

rows.requirement: Successful cells preserve normalized logical artifact names and producer provenance.
rows.setup: Real IPython cell stages text and binary artifacts.
rows.action: Commit cell and read result bindings/resolved bytes.
rows.expected: Names/media types/digests/sizes/operation/attempt/workspace/cell provenance match exactly.

rows.requirement: Failed/cancelled/suspended cells do not publish deliverable artifacts.
rows.setup: Cells stage artifact then raise, cancel or suspend.
rows.action: Read normal artifact/result APIs.
rows.expected: No deliverable binding/ref is visible; optional diagnostics are separately typed if configured.

rows.requirement: Multi-artifact publication is all-or-nothing at the CellCommitManifest boundary.
rows.setup: Three staged artifacts with injected failure during second/third storage or promotion.
rows.action: Execute and reconcile.
rows.expected: Before manifest none publish; after certain manifest all promote idempotently; no partial deliverable set.

rows.requirement: Supervisor/process loss at each artifact staging/manifest/promotion point reconciles without loss or false success.
rows.setup: Full durable supervisor with fault injection at each boundary.
rows.action: Restart, reconcile, resolve artifacts and operation result.
rows.expected: Manifest-authorized promotion completes once; no-manifest staging never becomes deliverable.

rows.requirement: Artifact count, per-artifact bytes, total bytes, name length and media type are enforced before publication.
rows.setup: Boundary and over-bound candidates.
rows.action: Stage and commit.
rows.expected: Exact boundaries pass; over-bound fails certain with no publication.

rows.requirement: Artifact logical names are safe relative names and duplicate-name policy is deterministic.
rows.setup: Normal, duplicate, traversal, absolute, unicode and case-collision names.
rows.action: Validate/stage result manifest.
rows.expected: Safe unique names pass; invalid/colliding names fail before publication.

rows.requirement: Service-managed call longer than attempt lease retains ownership through an independent keeper.
rows.setup: 35-second deterministic fake broker call, 30-second lease.
rows.action: Run active attempt.
rows.expected: Multiple keeper heartbeats; no lease loss; one certain result.

rows.requirement: Caller-delegated wait releases attempt/lease and remains durable.
rows.setup: Job reaches unresolved model ticket.
rows.action: Advance time beyond normal attempt lease without committing ticket.
rows.expected: Operation remains waiting_external, no live lease/worker authority is claimed, ticket remains valid until cumulative deadline.

rows.requirement: Cancellation correctly handles running, staged and waiting work.
rows.setup: Active cell, pending ticket, send_reserved ticket and send_started external call; expose barriers immediately before and after the send-start CAS.
rows.action: Race cancellation/deadline with mark-send-started at every barrier, restart, and deliver late outcomes.
rows.expected: Pending/reserved work settles as cancelled_before_send with send evidence null when cancellation wins; mark-send-started loses on any stale control/cancellation/suspension/ticket/deadline/claim fence. If send-start wins, cancellation remains indeterminate until receipt/reconciliation. No post-cancel publication occurs.

rows.requirement: Pending/unclaimed caller ticket survives supervisor restart.
rows.setup: Full supervisor stopped after ticket publication.
rows.action: Restart, attach, claim, commit, continue.
rows.expected: Same ticket/revision/request digest; one successor attempt; no duplicate intent.

rows.requirement: After-send/no-receipt model or child outcome never blind-replays.
rows.setup: Claim ticket, record send boundary, lose host receipt/transport.
rows.action: Restart and reconcile with unavailable lookup, then deliver late result.
rows.expected: Outcome unknown/quarantine remains authoritative; no second physical dispatch; late result cannot downgrade state.

rows.requirement: Terminal/quarantined ticket and model-journal states are monotonic under racing writers.
rows.setup: Barrier-controlled reconcile and late completion threads.
rows.action: Race every terminal pair and replay each command.
rows.expected: One authoritative terminal state; stale writers return it; no row downgrade or split projection.

rows.requirement: Stale attempt cannot write inner broker/RLM/artifact/workspace/result state after lease or generation loss.
rows.setup: Two successor attempts with barrier-controlled stale completion.
rows.action: Allow old provider/worker completion after successor ownership.
rows.expected: Every stale mutation is rejected; immutable certain receipt may be reused only through reconciler.

rows.requirement: Worker loss before/after broker suspension and cell commit resumes only from a certain boundary.
rows.setup: Kill worker at pre-cell, broker intent, settled receipt and post-cell checkpoint points.
rows.action: Restart/reconcile each case.
rows.expected: Resume surviving stacks or recovery-plan new cells; never auto-replay a lost cell; park unsupported/unknown cases with no duplicate work/publication.

rows.requirement: Unportable live state required after worker loss fails explicitly.
rows.setup: Cell depends on an excluded live object before caller work.
rows.action: Attempt suspension/recovery.
rows.expected: No false portable checkpoint; operation requests artifact-backed projection or parks with exact exclusions.

rows.requirement: Total deadline and all cumulative budgets include running, waiting, corrections, recovery planners and successor attempts.
rows.setup: Fake clock with multiple suspension/resume/recovery cycles.
rows.action: Consume each budget at and beyond the boundary.
rows.expected: Exact boundary allowed; overrun terminalizes once with complete accounting and no new work.

rows.requirement: Workbench job submission is idempotent and payload-bound across reconnects and retries.
rows.setup: One valid request context/idempotency key plus same and conflicting payload variants.
rows.action: Submit concurrently, replay after disconnect, reuse the key with changed spec, and use a fresh key.
rows.expected: Same key+payload returns one operation; changed payload conflicts before mutation; fresh key creates a distinct operation.

rows.requirement: One job's requested provider/model/effort route is immutable and exact.
rows.setup: Caller and service-managed fake route registries.
rows.action: Request same-route calls, route drift, missing profile and different route in separate job.
rows.expected: Same job cannot drift; separate job may bind another route; missing/stale profile fails before send.

rows.requirement: Usage totals count each logical/physical model call once and preserve evidence tier.
rows.setup: Known provider/reference/estimated receipt fixtures with replay.
rows.action: Commit/replay and read job result.
rows.expected: No double count; requested/caller-observed/host-bound/provider-attested evidence remains distinct.

rows.requirement: No hidden provider, model, effort, execution-mode or fallback drift occurs.
rows.setup: Adversarial host observations and registry responses.
rows.action: Commit mismatched effective route/fallback and trigger unsupported stream/retry behavior.
rows.expected: Fail closed with no successful result claim; fallback list remains empty unless explicitly admitted.

rows.requirement: Planner output is bound to ModelRequest v2 response contract before any directive or Python source is admitted.
rows.setup: Valid directive plus malformed JSON, wrong schema version, unknown fields, oversized bytes, remote-ref schema and semantically invalid code directive.
rows.action: Fulfill planner tickets with each response under bounded correction budgets.
rows.expected: Only the exact valid response creates a directive; invalid responses correct within budget or fail certain without workspace/code mutation.

rows.requirement: Accepted recursive work returns a retained host child handle and bounded result/artifact receipts.
rows.setup: Caller-delegated child host fake with exact parent identity.
rows.action: Submit, claim, return handle, poll/read result, replay.
rows.expected: One child, stable handle, exact parent lineage, one counted result; reference fake is separately labeled.

rows.requirement: Subagent count and recursion depth are cumulative and fail before over-budget launch.
rows.setup: Nested fake child requests at boundary/over-bound depth.
rows.action: Submit recursively.
rows.expected: Boundary succeeds; next request denied before host admission; trace/accounting exact.

rows.requirement: Unknown child submission/result outcome never creates a duplicate child.
rows.setup: Lose transport after host accepts child but before AAR receipt.
rows.action: Restart and reconcile by retained request/host receipt identity.
rows.expected: Original child is recovered or operation parks; no resubmit.

rows.requirement: Parent cancellation propagates as a host request without inventing child cancellation success.
rows.setup: Unclaimed, running and terminal fake children.
rows.action: Cancel parent and deliver host observations.
rows.expected: Each child state is exact; unknown remains unknown; parent finalization obeys required-child policy.

rows.requirement: Credentials and unredacted environment values never enter worker frames, DB, events, artifacts, traces or result.
rows.setup: Sentinel credentials in host environment and injected provider errors.
rows.action: Run model/child success/failure/restart paths and scan bounded outputs/storage.
rows.expected: No sentinel occurrence; only redacted credential-owner metadata.

rows.requirement: Model-written Python cannot directly execute privileged host effects through the facade.
rows.setup: Effect grant permutations and adversarial Python.
rows.action: Call effects.propose and attempt raw execution/fake privileged methods.
rows.expected: Only typed intent is produced; host authorization/receipt required; missing grants fail closed.

rows.requirement: Capabilities and docs continue to deny security sandbox/public arbitrary-code claims unless separately verified.
rows.setup: Generated capability/profile/docs assets.
rows.action: Read unsupported/security rows and public tool schemas.
rows.expected: Local process-isolation boundary explicit; public plugin has no workbench tool/code field.

rows.requirement: Direct/MCP v1 aar_rlm_execute behavior remains compatible.
rows.setup: Frozen v1 direct and MCP scenarios.
rows.action: Run against successor.
rows.expected: Same canonical results/failures; no implicit workspace binding or caller-ticket behavior.

rows.requirement: Current public caller-delegated RLM lifecycle and curated no-code surface remain compatible.
rows.setup: Frozen public scenarios and exact-wheel HTTP deployment.
rows.action: Run start/claim/commit/status/cancel/restart and tool-catalog checks.
rows.expected: Public v1 JSON/lifecycle/digests unchanged or explicitly versioned; no arbitrary Python exposure.

rows.requirement: Generated Hermes and Codex profiles install, start, report exact capabilities and complete the guided native workbench journey.
rows.setup: Exact successor wheel in fresh supported hosts.
rows.action: Install/restart/fresh-session, run skill-guided job with fake caller hosts.
rows.expected: Exact package/surface/skill/supervisor identities; model/subagent capability truth matches configuration; terminal artifact readback passes.

rows.requirement: Package inventory, tool surface, skill digest, release status and schema bundle are internally complete.
rows.setup: Build exact wheel and generated profile assets.
rows.action: Compare source/cache/wheel inventories and run asset verifiers.
rows.expected: No missing/stale source, schema, fixture, profile, skill or migration asset.

rows.requirement: Result/trace account for every model, child, cell, suspension, replay, artifact and budget delta exactly once.
rows.setup: Composite fake job with replay and one failed optional action.
rows.action: Read bounded trace/result and reconcile against fixture ledger.
rows.expected: Exact counts/digests/evidence tiers; no prompts/credentials/unbounded payloads in trace.

rows.requirement: Progress/display events from suspended, resumed or lost cells are provisional, stably identified and never double-counted as committed history.
rows.setup: Cell emits progress/display before broker suspension; exercise live resume and lost-stack recovery continuation.
rows.action: Read live events during each attempt and committed events after cell settlement.
rows.expected: Provisional events are deduplicated or discarded by cell ID; committed cursor contains each committed logical event once.

rows.requirement: Bundled operation skill guides the complete journey without granting authority or instructing manual RLM/workspace composition.
rows.setup: Fresh host profile with canonical skill.
rows.action: Run guided valid and stale/denied/cancel/reconcile scenarios.
rows.expected: Agent discovers capabilities, submits one workbench job, fulfills caller tickets, resolves artifacts and reports limits correctly.

rows.requirement: Exact installed wheel completes the entire fake-host workbench journey through the full MCP.
rows.setup: Fresh runtime root, attached supervisor, exact wheel, fake caller model/subagent hosts.
rows.action: Planner cell -> recursive model -> child -> named artifacts -> complete -> resolve.
rows.expected: All required journey/identity/accounting assertions pass and DB integrity is clean.

rows.requirement: Exact installed candidate survives supervisor/worker/frontend loss across every certain boundary.
rows.setup: Fault-injection installation with preserved runtime DB and checkpoints.
rows.action: Kill each process at matrix-defined points, restart and reconcile.
rows.expected: Certain continuation or explicit park; no duplicate call/child/artifact/result; stale generations fenced.

rows.requirement: Fresh Hermes host reads and exercises the exact configured caller-work capability after one restart/new session.
rows.setup: Exact wheel/profile in fresh Hermes with non-billable fake caller handlers.
rows.action: Read capabilities and complete one native workbench job.
rows.expected: Live configuration/prose/skill agree; no fake model/child is misreported as real; artifact/result readback passes.

rows.requirement: Separately authorized Luna/max and real retained child qualification completes one bounded workbench job with honest route/usage evidence tiers.
rows.setup: Immutable candidate, fixed provider/model/effort, tools policy, zero fallback, one real host child adapter, credential-owner approval.
rows.action: Run one small task with a hidden deterministic verifier and reconcile provider/child receipts.
rows.expected: Verified artifact/output, one terminal result, exact logical calls/children, no secret leakage; unsupported provider attestation remains labeled unknown.
